name: obsidian-knowledge-agent
description: A self-evolving knowledge agent: turns raw material into teaching-quality Obsidian notes and learns your vault's conventions from every run.

plugins.name: obsidian-knowledge
plugins.description: Self-evolving ingest -> compile -> distribute pipeline for Obsidian. Classifies raw material, scaffolds a folder tree, writes notes that teach, builds a concept-graph canvas, validates wikilinks, then reflects on each run to improve its own rules.
